changelog:
### Release 1.1.25

- Adds local on-demand HUD compilation inside the Windows launcher for supported Minecraft 1.21+ Fabric versions.
- Bundles legacy, modern, and official-mapping source templates plus their verified Gradle wrappers.
- Automatically resolves Fabric Loader, Fabric API, and Yarn mappings for the selected version.
- Downloads a managed JDK 21 or JDK 25 when compilation requires it and caches successful exact-version JARs.
- Validates the compiled JAR, Fabric mod ID, and exact Minecraft dependency before installation.
- Falls back safely when mappings are unavailable or source changes are required; Minecraft launches without an incompatible adapter.
